audit.site: Trichy Fetal Medicine and Fertility Centre
audit.method: INDEXABLE=1 production build + next start on localhost:3101; all 93 sitemap URLs + 9 extras fetched raw with Googlebot/GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot UAs (seo-audit/crawl.mjs); source review; live-domain verification
audit.deployment: Next.js build is LIVE on fmctrichy.com; previous audit audited pre-deploy
audit.supersedes: Previous audit (score 66) covered 10 guides; this covers the post-PR#4 state with 60 guides

issues.title: Sitemap lists /privacy and /terms which render meta noindex
issues.evidence: <loc>https://fmctrichy.com/privacy</loc> present in sitemap.xml while the page HTML emits <meta name="robots" content="noindex"> (legal.draftPendingReview gates noindex but the static route list adds /privacy and /terms unconditionally).
issues.fix: Exclude noindex routes from app/sitemap.ts staticRoutes, or remove noindex once counsel signs off the copy.

issues.title: No named author/reviewer on any of 60 medical articles
issues.evidence: Byline renders 'Written and medically reviewed by the FMC Trichy clinical team' linking only to /doctors (app/guides/[slug]/page.tsx:253-266). reviewedBy unset on 60/60 guides in data/guides-blogs.ts while reviewStatus:'reviewed' + reviewedAt are set on all — site claims review without naming a reviewer.
issues.fix: Set reviewedBy to a doctor slug per guide after doctors confirm review ownership (client item). Named byline, reviewer card, doctor link and reviewedBy:Person schema activate automatically.

issues.title: Zero in-body links to /services/* and /doctors/* across all 60 guides
issues.evidence: Programmatic scan of data/guides-blogs.ts content blocks: 0 links to /services/ and 0 to /doctors/; the only service link is the relatedService end-card present on 45/60 guides (missing on 15).
issues.fix: Add contextual in-copy service links and doctor links; fill relatedService on the 15 missing guides: pcos-and-pregnancy, fertility-testing-for-couples, get-pregnant-naturally-with-pcos, how-pcos-affects-ovulation-fertility, tests-for-pcos-related-infertility, low-amh-vs-pcos-difference, when-to-see-fertility-specialist-pcos, what-makes-a-pregnancy-high-risk, high-risk-pregnancy-extra-scans-and-tests, pregnancy-after-ivf-extra-monitoring, fertility-tests-for-women-before-treatment, male-fertility-tests-semen-analysis, what-is-amh-fertility-test, follicular-monitoring-ovulation-scan, how-to-know-when-you-are-ovulating.

issues.title: MedicalWebPage 'about' falls back to generic 'Fetal medicine' on 50 guides
issues.evidence: GUIDE_ABOUT (lib/schema.ts:326) maps only the 10 original slugs; e.g. /guides/tiffa-scan-pregnancy-when-to-get emits about:{MedicalWebPage,'Fetal medicine'} — a page type, not the medical entity. No sameAs links to Wikipedia/Wikidata/MeSH anywhere.
issues.fix: Extend GUIDE_ABOUT (or move about into guide data) with the correct MedicalCondition/MedicalProcedure per guide plus sameAs links.

issues.title: 274/362 FAQ answers outside the 40-60 word band (mostly under)
issues.evidence: seo-audit/guide-checks.json — worst: get-pregnant-naturally-with-pcos 6/6 out; anomaly-found-20-week-scan-what-happens 5/5 (23-word answer); anomaly-scan-vs-normal-pregnancy-ultrasound 5/5; nipt pillar 4; what-does-anomaly-scan-check 4.
issues.fix: Expand thin answers to a direct answer + one supporting detail (40-60 words); trim >60 outliers.

issues.title: 58/93 titles and 11/93 meta descriptions outside target ranges
issues.evidence: Titles mostly under 50 chars (NIPT in Trichy=27, Twin Pregnancy=27, Anomaly Scan in Trichy=35); a few over 60. Descriptions out of range incl /services/recurrent-miscarriages-clinic (139), twin-pregnancy guide (177), 3 category pages (120-122).
issues.fix: Adjust seo.title/seo.description per page to 50-60 / 140-160; keep unique.

issues.title: AI-template fingerprints across the 50-guide batch
issues.evidence: 'Final Thoughts' H2 on 50 guides; 205 Title Case H2s on 40 guides; uniform skeleton (quick answer -> H2 Q&A -> takeaways -> FAQs -> sources) and exactly-5-links pattern; banned phrases: whether you're (pcos pillar), that said (recurrent-miscarriage), straightforward (anomaly pillar), genuinely x2.
issues.fix: Sentence-case all H2s; rename/vary the 'Final Thoughts' section; vary skeleton; remove flagged phrases. See seo-audit/ai-likeness.json per page.

issues.title: Doctor profiles are shells; no article lists; third doctor has no page
issues.evidence: registration/memberships/languages/experienceSinceYear/qualificationsDetailed all null/[] (data/doctors.ts:92-161); no 'articles reviewed' section rendered; Dr Nivethitha hasProfile:false yet appears in /doctors, llms.txt and clinic employee schema.
issues.fix: Fill typed-null fields (client); render guides-by-reviewer on doctor pages once ISS-202 lands; resolve Nivethitha profile vs listing.

issues.title: Five draft legal pages publicly render 'pending review' copy via footer links
issues.evidence: data/legal.ts draftPendingReview:true on all five; footer links to four of them; /accessibility is an unlinked orphan. Prebuild emits 5 counsel-pending warnings.
issues.fix: Counsel sign-off (client) or temporarily remove footer links to draft pages; decide /accessibility fate.

issues.title: Home page emits 7 JSON-LD scripts instead of one connected graph
issues.evidence: Rendered HTML: one graph (WebSite+WebPage+MedicalClinic+FAQPage) plus 3 standalone Person scripts and 3 standalone Course scripts.
issues.fix: Fold Person/Course nodes into pageGraph([...]) in app/page.tsx.

issues.title: No INR costs, no insurance answers, few quotable specifics
issues.evidence: 0 guides mention ₹/INR/Rs; NIPT guide has 'NIPT test cost: why prices can differ' H2 with no figures; 5 comparison tables across 60 guides.
issues.fix: Add client-confirmed cost ranges/drivers; add comparison tables to remaining vs-guides; add insurance coverage answers where relevant.

issues.title: Core Web Vitals unverified on deployed site
issues.evidence: Prior localhost lab: LCP 3.7-4.6s, TBT 90-280ms, CLS 0. Templates unchanged since.
issues.fix: Run PageSpeed Insights on live fmctrichy.com pages; verify LCP element (hero image, already priority).

issues.title: Doctor pages lack og:image
issues.evidence: summary_large_image twitter card with no og:image in rendered HTML.
issues.fix: Emit openGraph.images in app/doctors/[slug]/page.tsx metadata.

issues.title: 5 nice.org.uk source links 403 to curl
issues.evidence: All NICE URLs return 403 to curl even with browser UA — likely WAF bot-blocking, probably fine for users.
issues.fix: Verify in a real browser; replace only if actually dead.

issues.title: Pillar link appears late in 3 supporting guides
issues.evidence: First /guides/ link position from programmatic scan; all other supporting guides link pillar within first ~4 blocks.
issues.fix: Move/add a pillar mention in the intro blocks.

issues.title: Paginated /guides/page/2-5 indexable but absent from sitemap
issues.evidence: Pages return 200 with index,follow and self-canonical; not in sitemap.
issues.fix: Optional: either add to sitemap or set robots index:false on page>=2.

issues.title: Guide OG images are raw covers, not 1200x630 cards
issues.evidence: openGraph.images = cover webp; services have generated opengraph-image, guides don't.
issues.fix: Add opengraph-image generator for /guides/[slug].

issues.title: Indexability silently depends on build-time INDEXABLE/VERCEL_ENV
issues.evidence: app/layout.tsx:39-44, app/robots.ts:4-5, proxy.ts — verified correct on the live deploy, but a misconfigured redeploy silently ships noindex + Disallow:/ sitewide.
issues.fix: Document the env requirement in LAUNCH-CHECKLIST.md; optionally add a post-deploy assert on /robots.txt + robots meta.

issues.title: Cannibalisation watch: anomaly/nipt/nt clusters overlap service pages
issues.evidence: e.g. 'anomaly scan' intent spread across service page + pillar + tiffa + what-does-check + vs-normal guides with heavily overlapping titles.
issues.fix: Sharpen title/H1 intent per URL (book-in-Trichy vs learn vs compare); monitor GSC for query splits.

issues.title: Client-supplied data missing (unblocks multiple fixes)
issues.evidence: Typed-null fields across data/site.ts + data/doctors.ts; launch-gate lists 9 blockers + 18 post-launch items.
issues.fix: Registration numbers, per-guide reviewer ownership, legal sign-offs, PCPNDT/CEA/ART regs, GBP details, social sameAs, geo, WhatsApp number, testimonial consents, claim substantiation, cost figures, landmark directions.
